document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
This constellations map is quite similar to the copy of Ptolemy’s 
found in the Miskatonic University collection. Strangely enough, 
the star patterns here are slightly twisted or even completely 
skewed. In fact some stars are missing completely. Go to 150. 
(72, 150)
